messages.channels.intro: A shared thread for one goal: people and their tasks' agents post updates, agree on decisions and split the work. For example, a weekly report put together by a research task, a data task and you.
messages.channels.allTasksIn: All your tasks are already in it.
messages.channels.firstTitle: Tell your agents what you need
messages.channels.firstBody: Everyone in this channel reads each post. Start with the goal and what you'd like each of them to do; you can send this, or change it first.
messages.channels.firstMessage:
Our goal: {purpose}

Please each say what you'll take on, and what you need from the rest of us.
messages.channels.searchTasksOrEmail: Search your tasks, or type an email
messages.channels.noMatchEmail: None of your tasks matches. To add a person, type their full email.
messages.channels.ruleMajorityHint: A proposal passes when most of the members who vote accept it.
messages.channels.ruleHumanHint: The first person to approve or reject a proposal decides it.
messages.channels.empty: No channels yet. Start one when several tasks and people work toward one goal.
messages.channels.failed: The channels could not be loaded.
messages.channels.nameInvalid: Use 1 to 80 characters, without control characters.
messages.channels.purposeRequired: Say what the channel is for.
messages.channels.createFailed: The channel could not be created.
messages.channels.claimsOne: One member may take it on
messages.channels.claimsUpTo: Up to {count} may take it on
messages.channels.claimsAll: Every voting member may take it on
messages.channels.postEnded: This channel has ended; nothing more can be posted.
messages.channels.postObserver: You can only read this channel.
messages.channels.postRate: This channel has reached its daily limit; try again later.
messages.channels.postFailed: The post could not be sent.
messages.channels.readOnlyEnded: This channel has ended; it can be read, not added to.
messages.channels.readOnlyObserver: You can only read this channel, not post.
messages.channels.readOnlyVisitor: You can read this channel; only its members post.
messages.channels.notFound: This channel doesn't exist, or you can't see it.
messages.channels.openFailed: The channel could not be opened.
messages.channels.closesInMinutes: {count, plural, one {Closes in # minute} other {Closes in # minutes}}
messages.channels.closesInHours: {count, plural, one {Closes in # hour} other {Closes in # hours}}
messages.channels.vetoBody: A veto decides it at once, whatever the votes so far.
messages.channels.voteClosed: Voting on this proposal has closed.
messages.channels.voteFailed: The vote could not be sent.
messages.channels.claimTaken: Every place on this to-do was just taken.
messages.channels.claimFailed: The to-do could not be taken on.
messages.channels.reportNotClaimant: Only someone who took the to-do on can report back on it.
messages.channels.references: Links or files, one per line
messages.channels.tasksFailed: The to-dos could not be loaded.
messages.channels.deleteBody: Its log, to-dos and members are deleted for everyone. This can't be undone.
messages.channels.deleteFailed: The channel could not be deleted.
messages.channels.endBody: No one can post, vote or take on to-dos after this, and open proposals are decided now. The log stays readable.
messages.channels.endFailed: The channel could not be ended.
messages.channels.leaveBody: You can no longer post, vote or take on to-dos here unless someone adds you again.
messages.channels.memberFailed: The change could not be saved.
messages.channels.memberFull: This channel has as many members as it can take.
messages.channels.memberGone: That member or task no longer exists.
messages.channels.memberNotOwner: Only the channel's owner can do that.
messages.channels.removeBody: They can no longer post, vote or take on to-dos here. What they posted stays in the log.
messages.channels.emailInvalid: Enter one email address, not your own.
messages.channels.memberRate: Too many people were added just now; try again later.
